night-owl-comment.displayName: Night Owl Comment (retuned to Ledger chalk-dim; 5.99:1 on #011627)

display.purpose: Home statement only. Schibsted Grotesk 400, --fs-display clamp(2.3rem, 5.4vw, 4.9rem) (77.76px at 1440); --fs-display-sm clamp(2.1rem, 9.6vw, 3rem) at <=48rem. Accent clause italic in --accent-text.

h1.purpose: Page-hero titles. Schibsted Grotesk 400, --fs-h1 clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4rem): 64px at 1440, 40px at 390. No eyebrow chip above it.

h2.purpose: Every h2 on every route. Schibsted Grotesk 400, --fs-h2 clamp(1.5rem, 2.4vw, 1.875rem): 30px at 1440, 24px at 390. Route styles never set an h2 size.

body.purpose: Schibsted Grotesk 400, 1rem / 1.65; prose 1.16rem / 1.65. Running text is never positively tracked.

label.purpose: IBM Plex Mono: metadata 0.82rem uppercase +0.08em in --text-dim; counts 0.78rem +0.06em; labels 0.75rem +0.1em; EXIF captions 0.75rem +0.02em (the functional floor); gallery index 0.8rem sentence case, untracked.

shadows.name: none-on-content
shadows.purpose: Cards, list rows, header and heroes carry no shadow. Shadows are reserved for floating layers: the lightbox metadata sheet, the gallery loading-status pill and lightbox tooltips. The rest of the lightbox chrome is shadowless on its ink backdrop. Shelf book covers get no shadow or lift (accent border on hover only). The book detail cover keeps a flat rust offset.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default deceleration for transforms and reveals.

motion.name: dur-base
motion.purpose: Standard transition duration; reduced-motion collapses all to 0.01ms.

motion.name: dur-slow
motion.purpose: The main content-rise entrance (fade from 10px below) on each page load; collapses under reduced motion.

fonts.role: headings, home statement, body, prose, nav, ledger, caption titles
dates, counts, labels, captions, gallery index, code

layout.name: gutter
layout.purpose: The one inline inset for header, main and footer; shared left edge x=152 at 1440, x=16 at 390.

layout.name: header-h
layout.purpose: Single-row sticky solid header (brand · nav · theme toggle).

layout.name: row-inset
layout.purpose: Top inset of a ruled list row below its hairline (border-top + padding: 1rem 0); 1.5rem for cards and sections, 0.75rem for /uses inventory rows. Text never sits flush on a hairline.

components.name: Ledger Link
components.description: Home hero door: Schibsted label with a build-time mono count, ruled hairline that turns rust on hover.
components.css: .ds-ledger { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.6rem; padding-block: 0.35rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(24, 25, 26, 0.18); font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #18191a; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.24s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 0.24s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-ledger span { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #43474a; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ledger:hover { border-color: #a8401e; color: #8a3216; } .ds-ledger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a8401e; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat list card: top hairline plus a top inset (padding: 1.5rem 0; list rows 1rem 0) and whitespace only; no box, radius, left rule or shadow. Clickable cards (.card-link): the whole card is the hit area; hover turns the top hairline rust (55% mix into --line) and adds a 14% rust wash, colour only, 0px movement; focus draws the 2px ring around the card.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { padding: 1.5rem 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(24, 25, 26, 0.18); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #18191a; } .ds-card:hover { border-top-color: color-mix(in srgb, #a8401e 55%, rgba(24, 25, 26, 0.18)); background: color-mix(in srgb, #efc9b8 14%, transparent); } .ds-card-date { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5b5f62; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0.5rem 0; font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1.65; }

narrative.northStar: Ledger — an engineer's working ledger that also keeps the photographs
narrative.overview: One identity: stone-grey paper, graphite ink and a single rust accent, light first (and the no-JS fallback) with a neutral slate dark theme; the theme follows the stored choice, then the system preference, never the page. Schibsted Grotesk speaks and reads (titles, the home statement, prose, nav), IBM Plex Mono records (dates, counts, EXIF, labels). Engineering and photography share one ledger, not two visual systems.
keyCharacteristics: One identity, one accent: rust in both themes, at both ends of every gradient token
Text hierarchy dim < muted < text with a 4.5:1 floor in both themes on every ground
Grotesque/mono voice split; one H2 size (--fs-h2) everywhere
Flat: top hairlines with a top inset and whitespace, no card boxes, left rules or shadows
Page heroes are H1 + lede only: no eyebrow chips
Truth in details: build-time counts, real EXIF captions, measured contrast

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Rust is the only accent hue in both themes. If a second accent hue appears in chrome, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Whisper Rule
rules.body: Gradients are whispers, never banners: --gradient-hero is none and page-hero glow caps at 0.04-0.05 opacity. No gradient text.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Text never sits on a photograph; contrast comes from tokens, never from photo measurements.

rules.name: The One H2 Rule
rules.body: Every h2 is --fs-h2 (30px at 1440, 24px at 390). Route styles never set an h2 size.

rules.name: The Floor Rule
rules.body: Functional text is at least 0.75rem (12px) and at least 4.5:1 against its ground, code tokens included.

rules.name: The Tracking Rule
rules.body: Positive tracking >= 0.05em is only for uppercase mono labels (meta, count, label). Running text, nav rows and the gallery index are untracked.

rules.name: The One Edge Rule
rules.body: Header, main and footer share one container inset by --gutter; nothing inside adds inline padding.

dos: Do take every colour, size and font from v2-tokens.scss; add a token there before using a new value.
Do write font-family: var(--font-*) with no appended fallbacks; the tokens carry their own stacks.
Do keep dim < muted < text and the 4.5:1 floor in both themes.
Do use --accent-text for rust text and --accent-start for rust strokes.
Do give every ruled row a top inset below its hairline.
Do compute every count from the collection or manifest the linked page renders.
Do caption photographs with their real title and EXIF; drop missing fields.
donts: Don't reintroduce a dual-identity theme switch or a second accent hue.
Don't set an h2 size in a route stylesheet or a size off the ramp.
Don't load a family other than Schibsted Grotesk and IBM Plex Mono, or a weight outside the requested faces.
Don't put an eyebrow chip above a page-hero H1, or a left rule on a label.
Don't put text on a photograph or crop a frame to fit a grid.
Don't make the header transparent, blurred, two-row or scroll-aware.
Don't fabricate content, counts, testimonials or EXIF.
